source.note: Values below are read from the .sketch file. docs/design/artboards.json holds the full layer dump (frames, fills, borders, shadows, text styles) for anything not listed here.

agentChoices._comment: Entries of this file that are not Sketch measurements. Every other value comes from the Sketch dump in docs/design/artboards.json.
agentChoices.layout.grid.header.columnWidthDay: 48. Agent choice. The Sketch has no Day artboard, see docs/decisions/2026-11-08-grill-session.md Q15.
agentChoices.layout.grid.header.columnWidthWeek: 114. Agent choice. The Sketch has no Week artboard, see docs/decisions/2026-11-08-grill-session.md Q15.
agentChoices.layout.badge.offsetFromBarEnd: 36. Measured in docs/design/artboards.json: the badge right edge sits 36px from the bar end in every bar of the Sketch artboards. That space holds the three-dot button (4px gap, 24px button, 8px to the bar end), so the badge never moves when the button appears. The token layout.badge.gapToBarEnd (8) is the gap of the three-dot button to the bar end.
agentChoices.layout.bar.actionsButton: u3-bars, 2026-11-10: measured from the export of 'Options CTA Controls'. The symbol 'Buttons/Alt/Icon Subtle/Hover' is 24x24 but placed at 24x22, with radius 4 and fill #f1f3f8. A dot is a 1.5 oval with a 1.4 stroke, so it renders 3 wide in #687196 (the group fill), centres 5.25 apart (group 13.5). menuGap 5: the menu top is 5 below the button.
agentChoices.layout.bar.actionsButton.pressedFill: u3-fix, 2026-11-10: #d8dceb, measured on the export of 'Edit and Delete Controls Expanded' (853,314 / 856,318 / 870,314 / 853,330). The fill of the symbol 'Buttons/Alt/Icon Subtle/Hover' is not in artboards.json. The button uses it while its menu is open.
agentChoices.layout.dropdownMenu.rowHoverFill: u3-bars, 2026-11-10: #f1f3f8, the fill of the second hidden row rectangle of 'Dropdown/Simple Copy', the same fill as the hovered three-dot button. The #a4aac0 rectangle shows in no export.
agentChoices.layout.tooltip.gapToBar/showDelay: u3-bars, 2026-11-10: gapToBar 5 from 'Timeline - Hover Options' (tooltip bottom 418, bar top 423). showDelay 800ms is an agent choice: 'Options CTA Controls' shows a hovered bar with no tooltip, so the tooltip waits for a dwell longer than the 700 ms that a pixel check with wait@300 takes.
agentChoices.layout.grid (u2-fix): Added 2026-11-10 from the layers of 'Schedule - Default'. cellHover.pointerX 52: the box 'Rectangle' starts at x 675 and the pointer of 'Cursor/Hand/Pointing' is at about x 727, so the box centre is about 5px right of the pointer. cellHover.tooltipOffsetX -10: the tooltip 'Helpers/Button-Hover/Label' starts at x 665, 10px left of the box. bodyFillBottomGap 2: the body 'Rectangle' 483,309 is 713 high, so it ends at y 1022 and the page under it is white. Deleted: colors.surface.rowAlternate, rowHover, rowHoverAlpha (the grid uses railRowHoverFill and timelineRowHoverFill), layout.grid.header.labelPaddingX (the labels are centred), currentMonthMarker (the today line is the marker).
agentChoices.layout.grid (u2-grid): Fixed 2026-11-10 from docs/design/artboards.json and the export of 'Schedule - Default'. todayMarker: the old #3e40db 1px line was not in the design; the only line is 'Group 5/Line 3', 3px #d4d7ff, 708 long, centred on the left edge of the current month (export: y 238 to 946, so 709). verticalGridLine.length: the column lines of 'Group 5' are 747 long from the header bottom line. The header has no column separators and a white fill. The timeline body is #f7f9fc ('Rectangle' 483,309), the first row is white. The rail rows are white, the hovered rail row #fafbfd, the hovered timeline row #eef0ff. cellHover: 'Rectangle' 675,303 113x38, #6570ff at 10%, 1px inside border #c3c7ff, radius 8 measured from the export corners. The tooltip 'Helpers/Button-Hover/Label' 130x26 hangs 5px over the box. The today line is the marker, so currentMonthMarker is deleted.
agentChoices.layout.page.title: Added 2026-11-10: the Sketch symbol Table/Header/3 at y 97 holds the title text layer at y -2, so the 34px line box starts at y 95.
agentChoices.components.scaleChip: Fixed 2026-11-10 from docs/design/artboards.json (unit u1-top). The chip is one white 146x25 rectangle, radius 5, shadow 1,2.5 blur 3 #c8cfe9. The label segment is #f1f3f8 at 75%. The value segment has no fill. The chip has no border: the old #979797 border and the #e6ebf0 value fill were Sketch placeholders. The chevron is the line icon 'Nao_Icons/Line/Arrow/Simple/Down' at (129.53, 10.91) in the chip, #687196, and #5659ff while the menu is open. The text boxes sit at y 4 in the chip, 16 high. The menu hangs 5px under the chip at its left edge (View Selection: Dropdown/Simple at 101,185).
agentChoices.shadow spread: Added 2026-11-10. docs/design/extract.mjs dropped the Sketch shadow spread. It now writes it into artboards.json. Most shadows have a negative spread (-1 to -8). Use it as the 4th box-shadow length.
agentChoices.layout.dropdownMenu.shadow2 and border: Added 2026-11-10 from the symbol 'Dropdown/Simple': a second shadow 0,2.5 blur 3 #c8cfe9 and a 1px border #687196 at 10%.
agentChoices.components.badge.border and components.b: Disabled in the Sketch instances (isEnabled: false). The rendered badge has no border and the rendered bar has no shadow, so the app draws neither.
agentChoices.layout.panel and components (u4-drawer): Panel shadows, overlay, focus ring, field shadows, status pill and menu come from the four Create New Event artboards. The datepicker popup is not in any artboard: it uses the dropdown menu tokens (radius, border, shadows, row hover) and the button primary fill for the selected day. slideDuration is an agent choice. Measured on the exports: placeholder colour is #a4aac0 (was #687196); the Work Order Name field sits at x 874, one pixel right of the other fields; button text and subtitle sit 1px lower than the Chromium line box puts them (textOffsetY 1, subtitle.y 47 instead of the layer y 46). The status chevron has no box in any export, only the #687196 triangle. Only the Open pill has a border in the export; the other pills have none. statusPill.insetX counts from inside the field border; offsetY 1 puts the pill at y 226 as in the export. chevron.insetRight is from the outer field edge to the triangle (layer x 1395.36).
agentChoices.layout.panel and components (u4-fix): Status Dropdown artboard: the Blocked row of Dropdown/Simple Copy has fill #d8dceb (the other rows #f1f3f8) and text #030929. That is the hovered row. The export shows no row fill, so hover changes only the text colour (statusMenu.hoverColor), on every row except the selected one. The row text layers sit at row y + 5, 1px under the Chromium centre (statusMenu.textOffsetY 1). The collapsed pill sits at y 226 (offsetY 1), but at y 225 while the list is open (openOffsetY 0). The chevron of With Selection is #b3b7ca, the other three artboards #687196: the app keeps #687196. Datepicker: datepicker.navPaddingX and typography.styles.datepickerMonth are agent choices (no artboard shows the popup). Borders: dropdownMenu.borderWidth 1 (border thickness 1) and panel.divider.width 1 (Line 3 thickness 1).
agentChoices.components.formError (u5-actions): No artboard shows an error state. The error text uses the Blocked status colours: text #b13600 (colors.status.blocked.text), and the overlap alert uses the Blocked bar fill #fffcf1 and border #fff5cf. Type is the control label style (Regular 14). The radius is the text field radius 5. gapY, padY, padX and marginTop are agent choices. The overlap alert sits under the panel head, above the fields: the buttons are in the head, so no space is free above them.
agentChoices.layout.focusRing (b3-a11y-fix): The design has no keyboard focus state for buttons, menu items or bars. Every :focus-visible outline uses color.border.focus, width 1 and offset -1: the ring sits inside the box, so it does not change the layout or touch a neighbour. It shows only for keyboard focus, so no pixel changes at rest.

notInDesign.dayAndWeekLayout: Sketch only shows the Month timescale. Day column width 48 and Week column width 114 are agent choices, locked in docs/decisions/2026-11-08-grill-session.md (Q15). Header formats: Month = 'Mon YYYY', Week = week start date, Day = day number.
notInDesign.overlapError: No error state exists in the file. Copy, colour and placement are open decisions.
notInDesign.panelRadius: Panel radius 12 comes from the create-panel artboard; panel is flat against the page in the render.
notInDesign.barExtraLabels: The layer named 'McMarrow Plastics' inside bars is white text on a light fill and is not visible in the render - treat it as leftover, not a required field.
